from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

# Define the fixed list of causes of action provided in the task
CauseCategory = Literal[
    '执行案由 - 刑事',
    '执行案由 - 行政',
    '行政行为 - 行政合同',
    '行政行为 - 行政处罚',
    '行政主体 - 民政行政管理（民政）',
    '产品责任纠纷',
    '非刑事赔偿 - 错误执行赔偿',
    '适用特殊程序案件案由',
    '渎职罪',
    '执行案由 - 行政非诉执行',
    '物权保护纠纷',
    '行政行为 - 行政裁决',
    '刑事赔偿'
]

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted info from one judgment document for sorting."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the document (e.g. 《判决文书 1》)")
    cause_category: CauseCategory | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action this document belongs to, chosen from the task's fixed list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates document extractions for a single parsed document."""
    document_infos: list[DocumentInfo]
